name: ECW Hardcore TV
description: No rules. No regulations. The only commandment is to be extreme. Welcome to the show that started a revolution.

videos.title: ECW Hardcore TV - Nov. 28, 1992
videos.overview: The Sandman, The Super Destroyers and King Kahlua compete in this ECW television pilot from the fall of 1992.

videos.title: ECW Hardcore TV - Apr. 06, 1993
videos.overview: On this edition of Eastern Championship Wrestling, Jimmy 'Superfly' Snuka and others compete in a tournament to crown a new ECW Television Champion. Plus, Terry Funk makes a special appearance, The Super Destroyers defend the ECW Tag Team Titles against The Hell Riders, and much more!

videos.title: ECW Hardcore TV - Apr. 13, 1993
videos.overview: On this edition of Eastern Championship Wrestling, The Sandman defends the ECW Heavyweight Championship against The Kodiak Bear. The ECW TV Title Tournament continues when Hot Stuff Eddie Gilbert faces J.T. Smith. Plus, Super Ninja, Tony Stetson, and more in action!

videos.title: ECW Hardcore TV - Apr. 20, 1993
videos.overview: On this edition of Eastern Championship Wrestling, the ECW Television Title Tournament continues with Jimmy Snuka taking on Tommy Cairo, and Hot Stuff Eddie Gilbert battling Glen Osbourne. Plus, The Rockin' Rebel looks to shake The Sandman's tree, The Super Destroyers defend the ECW Tag Team Championships, and more!

videos.title: ECW Hardcore TV - Apr. 27, 1993
videos.overview: On this edition of Eastern Championship Wrestling, Don Muraco and ECW TV Champion Jimmy Snuka join forces with Hot Stuff Eddie Gilbert. Plus, The Rockin' Rebel challenges The Sandman for the ECW Heavyweight Championship, The Suicide Blondes debut against Tommy Cairo and J.T. Smith, and much more!

videos.title: ECW Hardcore TV - May. 04, 1993
videos.overview: Things take a dangerous turn when 'Hot Stuff Eddie Gilbert and Don Muraco receive some help from an unexpected ally during their match against Glen Osbourne and J.T. Smith. Plus, Commissioner Tod Gordon gives Hunter Q. Robbins Ill a taste of his own medicine, The Sandman defends the ECW Heavyweight Championship against Sal Bellomo, and more!

videos.title: ECW Hardcore TV - May. 11, 1993
videos.overview: While Terry Funk prepares for his confrontation with Hot Stuff Eddie Gilbert, the merger of Hot Stuff International and Paul E. Dangerously's Dangerous Alliance spells trouble for ECW President Tod Gordon. The Rockin' Rebel and Tigra face Miss Peaches and ECW Heavyweight Champion The Sandman in a Mixed Tag Team Match. All this and much more!

videos.title: ECW Hardcore TV - May. 18, 1993
videos.overview: Both Tigra and Miss Peaches are barred from ringside when The Sandman defends the ECW Heavyweight Championship against The Rockin' Rebel in the main event. Plus, ECW Tag Team Champions Tony Stetson & Larry Winters face The Suicide Blondes in a non-title match, "Hot Stuff" Eddie Gilbert & Jimmy Snuka take on J.T. Smith & Max Thrasher, and more.

videos.title: ECW Hardcore TV - May. 25, 1993
videos.overview: Paul E. Dangerously pressures ECW President Tod Gordon to give Don Muraco a shot at the ECW Heavyweight Championship. Terry Funk sends a message to Hot Stuff Eddie Gilbert. Plus, The Suicide Blondes challenge Tony Stetson and Larry Winters for the ECW Tag Team Championships, Jimmy Snuka defends the ECW TV Title, and more!

videos.title: ECW Hardcore TV - Jun. 01, 1993
videos.overview: On this edition of Eastern Championship Wrestling, the ECW Heavyweight Championship is on the line when The Sandman defends the title against Don Muraco. Plus, J.T. Smith in action, Hot Stuff Eddie Gilbert and ECW TV Champion Jimmy Snuka face Glen Osbourne and Tommy Cairo, and more!

videos.title: ECW Hardcore TV - Jun. 08, 1993
videos.overview: The Sandman looks for redemption by challenging Don Muraco for the ECW Heavyweight Championship in a main event rematch. Tensions between The Super Destroyers and ECW Tag Team Champions The Suicide Blondes explode, Terry Funk's rivalry with Hot Stuff Eddie Gilbert continues, and more!

videos.title: ECW Hardcore TV - Jun. 15, 1993
videos.overview: On this edition of Eastern Championship Wrestling, Road Warrior Hawk challenges Jimmy 'Superfly' Snuka for the ECW TV Title. Plus, Terry Funk goes one-on-one with The Dark Patriot in the main event, 'Hot Stuff' Eddie Gilbert competes in a Chain Match, and much more!

videos.title: ECW Hardcore TV - Jun. 22, 1993
videos.overview: Violence erupts when Hunter Q. Robbins Ill leads The Suicide Blondes into main event action against Sal Bellomo and The Super Destroyers. Tommy Cairo takes Road Warrior Hawk's place in challenging Don Muraco for the ECW Heavyweight Championship. All this and much more!

videos.title: ECW Hardcore TV - Jun. 29, 1993
videos.overview: On this edition of Eastern Championship Wrestling, Jimmy 'Superfly' Snuka puts the ECW TV Title on the line in a match against Tommy Cairo. Plus, Ivan and Vladimir Koloff in action, a look at how Hot Stuff Eddie Gilbert became King of Philadelphia, Sir Richard Michaels takes on Sal Bellomo, and much more!

videos.title: ECW Hardcore TV - Jul. 06, 1993
videos.overview: On this edition of Eastern Championship Wrestling, The Super Destroyers put their masks on the line when they challenge The Suicide Blondes for the ECW Tag Team Championships. Plus, The Sandman battles Ivan Koloff for a shot at the ECW Heavyweight Title, ECW President Tod Gordon vows to lay down the law, and much more!

videos.title: ECW Hardcore TV - Jul. 20, 1993
videos.overview: On this edition of Eastern Championship Wrestling, Jimmy Snuka defends the ECW Television Championship against Terry Funk in the main event. Plus, The Suicide Blondes challenge The Super Destroyers for the ECW Tag Team Championships, King Hot Stuff Eddie Gilbert goes on a tour of his kingdom, and much more!

videos.title: ECW Hardcore TV - Jul. 27, 1993
videos.overview: After invading Commissioner Tod Gordon's press conference, Hot Stuff Eddie Gilbert demands respect as the so-called 'King of Philadelphia' and takes over this edition of Eastern Championship Wrestling. Plus, Terry Funk in action, The Sandman goes one-on-one with Sir Jonathan Hotbody, and much more!

videos.title: ECW Hardcore TV - Aug. 03, 1993
videos.overview: Commissioner Tod Gordon regains control of this edition of Eastern Championship Wrestling and gives some insight into the upcoming matches at UltraClash, featuring ECW TV Champion Jimmy Snuka, J.T. Smith, The Dark Patriot, and many more! Plus, a special appearance from the so-called 'King of Philadelphia', Hot Stuff Eddie Gilbert.

videos.title: ECW Hardcore TV - Aug. 10, 1993
videos.overview: On a very special edition of Eastern Championship Wrestling, join Jay Sulli for a journey back through time to revisit the Best of ECW thus far, including Don Muraco challenging The Sandman for the coveted ECW Heavyweight Championship, the merger between Hot Stuff International and Paul E. Dangerously's Dangerous Alliance, and much more!

videos.title: ECW Hardcore TV - Aug. 17, 1993
videos.overview: On this edition of Eastern Championship Wrestling, Stan The Lariat' Hansen makes a huge statement by challenging Jimmy Snuka for the ECW Television Championship. Plus, the First Round of the ECW Tag Team Tournament begins, Don Muraco defends the ECW Heavyweight Title, and much more!

videos.title: ECW Hardcore TV - Aug. 24, 1993
videos.overview: Tito Santana challenges The Magnificent Don Muraco for the ECW Heavyweight Championship in the main event. Plus, Shane Douglas aligns himself with a dangerous group of men, "Hot Stuff" Eddie Gilbert & The Dark Patriot compete against Tommy Cairo & J.T. Smith in the ECW Tag Team Championship Tournament, and much more.

videos.title: ECW Hardcore TV - Aug. 31, 1993
videos.overview: On this edition of Eastern Championship Wrestling, things get heated when Stan 'The Lariat' Hansen and Tito Santana team up to take on Shane Douglas and Don Muraco in the main event. Plus, The Headhunters in action, 'Hot Stuff' Eddie Gilbert and The Dark Patriot face The Super Destroyers, and more!

videos.title: ECW Hardcore TV - Sep. 07, 1993
videos.overview: On this edition of Eastern Championship Wrestling, Stan The Lariat' Hansen prepares for UltraClash by taking on the duo of Twisted Steel and Sex Appeal in a Handicap Match. Plus, a look at 'Hot Stuff' Eddie Gilbert and The Dark Patriot going after the ECW Tag Team Titles, J.T. Smith faces Mr. Mortagi, and much more!

videos.title: ECW Hardcore TV - Sep. 14, 1993
videos.overview: On this edition of Eastern Championship Wrestling, join ECW President Tod Gordon and Jay Sulli for an exclusive preview of all the upcoming action at UltraClash, featuring The Super Destroyers, Tony Stetson, and many more. Plus, a huge announcement regarding Abdullah The Butcher's partner against Terry Funk and Stan Hansen.

videos.title: ECW Hardcore TV - Sep. 21, 1993
videos.overview: On this edition of Eastern Championship Wrestling, Jimmy Snuka defends the ECW Television Championship against The Metal Maniac. The Public Enemy battle Jason Knight and lan Rotten in a Tag Team Match main event. Plus, an update on Sal Bellomo's condition, highlights from UltraClash, and more!

videos.title: ECW Hardcore TV - Sep. 28, 1993
videos.overview: Witness highlights of the moments and rivalries leading up to NWA Bloodfest, including Tony Stetson defending the Pennsylvania State Heavyweight Championship against Tommy Cairo. Plus, a look at The Rockin' Rebel's recent actions against Sal Bellomo, Kevin Sullivan sends a message to Abdullah The Butcher, and more.

videos.title: ECW Hardcore TV - Oct. 05, 1993
videos.overview: In the main event, Terry Funk takes on Jimmy 'Superfly' Snuka in a Steel Cage Match for the ECW Television title. ECW legends square off when Sabu goes head to head with the Tazmaniac. Sandman faces the Metal Maniac. Public Enemy take on Gino Caruso and The Silver Jet in tag team action. Paul E. Dangerously and more.

videos.title: ECW Hardcore TV - Oct. 12, 1993
videos.overview: Don Muraco, Jimmy 'Superfly' Snuka, and Kevin Sullivan face Terry Funk, J.T. Smith, and Abdullah the Butcher in wild six-man tag team action. A special feature looking at the debut of Sabu. Malia Hosaka faces Molly McShane in women's action. The Bad Breed take on Bad Company. The Rockin Rebel vs. Don E. Allen. Paul E. Dangerously, and more.

videos.title: ECW Hardcore TV - Oct. 19, 1993
videos.overview: Main event features Tommy Dreamer going one on one against the Tazmaniac. Pat Tanaka & Paul Diamond take on the Public Enemy. Johnny Hotbody and Tony Stetson defend the ECW Tag Team titles against Sandman and J.T. Smith as Jimmy Superfly Snuka faces Chad Austin. Appearances from Shane Douglas, Terry Funk, and more.

videos.title: ECW Hardcore TV - Oct. 26, 1993
videos.overview: On this edition of Eastern Championship Wrestling, Terry Funk joins the corner of J.T. Smith when he takes to the ring to challenge Shane Douglas for the ECW Heavyweight Championship in the main event. The Public Enemy make a statement at the expense of Badd Company. Sal Bellomo returns to get even with The Rockin' Rebel. All this and more!

videos.title: ECW Hardcore TV - Nov. 02, 1993
videos.overview: Shane Douglas defends the ECW Heavyweight Championship against Sabu. The Bad Breed take on Chad Austin and Todd Shaw. Highlights of Shane Douglas vs. Sandman from UltraClash '93. Sherri Martel, Madusa, Kevin Sullivan, and more.

videos.title: ECW Hardcore TV - Nov. 09, 1993
videos.overview: Join Joey Styles in the ECW Control Center for a look at some exciting highlights of all the action and rivalries leading up to November to Remember, including Shane Douglas defending the ECW Heavyweight Championship against Sabu. Plus, Tommy Dreamer, The Rockin' Rebel, Terry Funk, and more on this edition of Eastern Championship Wrestling.

videos.title: ECW Hardcore TV - Nov. 16, 1993
videos.overview: On this edition of Eastern Championship Wrestling, witness highlights from November to Remember '93 and hear exclusive interviews with the Superstars who participated in the event, including Badd Company issuing a special challenge to The Public Enemy. Plus, Jim Neidhart faces The Sandman in a special bonus match!

videos.title: ECW Hardcore TV - Nov. 23, 1993
videos.overview: On this edition of Eastern Championship Wrestling, Chris Michaels goes one-on-one with Tommy Cairo in the main event. The Sandman and J.T. Smith battle former ECW Tag Team Champions Tony Stetson and Johnny Hotbody. Plus, Kevin Sullivan gives Keith Shearer a lesson in wrestling, highlights from November to Remember, and more!

videos.title: ECW Hardcore TV - Nov. 30, 1993
videos.overview: The Tazmaniac takes to the ring to challenge Sabu for the ECW Heavyweight Championship in an incredible confrontation. The Sandman & Miss Peaches team with J.T. Smith to take on Johnny Hotbody, Tony Stetson & Hunter Q. Robbins Ill. Plus, Jason unleashes Mr. Hughes, insight into The Public Enemy's assault on Badd Company, and more.

videos.title: ECW Hardcore TV - Dec. 07, 1993
videos.overview: After going one-on-one with Jonathan Hotbody, J.T. Smith finds himself in harm's way when Kevin Sullivan and The Tazmaniac take on The Bad Breed of Axl and lan Rotten for a shot at the ECW Tag Team Titles. Plus, Paul E. Dangerously sends holiday wishes to Terry Funk, Shane Douglas maintains his loyalty to Sensational Sherri, and much more!

videos.title: ECW Hardcore TV - Dec. 14, 1993
videos.overview: ECW legends go to war when The Tazmaniac and Kevin Sullivan face the unlikely duo of Tommy Dreamer and Shane Douglas. Wildman Sal Bellomo squares off against Don E. Allen. Tony Stetson faces the Sandman. Plus Terry Funk, Sabu, a special look at the Public Enemy, and much more.

videos.title: ECW Hardcore TV - Dec. 21, 1993
videos.overview: Main event features a six-man tag team match pitting Wildman Sal Bellomo, J.T. Smith, and Sandman against Terry Funk, Axl Rotten, and lan Rotten. Shane Douglas goes one on one with Tommy Dreamer. Tazmaniac and Kevin Sullivan vs. Mike D and Mike Norman. Paul E. Dangerously, Jimmy Superfly Snuka, and more.

videos.title: ECW Hardcore TV - Dec. 28, 1993
videos.overview: On this edition of Eastern Championship Wrestling, take a look at some of the action and excitement from Holiday Hell, including Terry Funk battling Sabu for the ECW Heavyweight Championship. Plus, highlights of The Sandman's altercation with Jason and his entourage, The Rockin' Rebel in action, and much more!

videos.title: ECW Hardcore TV - Jan. 04, 1994
videos.overview: On the first Eastern Championship Wrestling of 1994, join Joey Styles for some exciting wrestling action and witness Terry Funk going one-on-one with Sabu for the ECW Heavyweight Championship. Plus, highlights of Mr. Hughes in action, a look at The Pitbull's altercation with The Sandman, and more!

videos.title: ECW Hardcore TV - Jan. 18, 1994
videos.overview: On a special edition of Eastern Championship Wrestling, Terry Funk puts the ECW Heavyweight Championship on the line against Shane Douglas in an incredible main event confrontation. Plus, 911 makes quick work of Chad Austin, ECW Tag Team Champions Kevin Sullivan and The Tazmaniac in action, and more!

videos.title: ECW Hardcore TV - Jan. 25, 1994
videos.overview: In the main event, The Tazmaniac and Kevin Sullivan take on Badd Company in a wild tag-team brawl. Terry Funk faces Pat Tanaka. The Public Enemy face Duane Gill and Don E. Allen in tag team action. Mr. Hughes squares off with Mikey Whipwreck in singles competition. Tommy Dreamer vs. Dr. Disaster and more.

videos.title: ECW Hardcore TV - Feb. 01, 1994
videos.overview: On this edition of Eastern Championship Wrestling, Commissioner Tod Gordon informs The Public Enemy that their actions have put them cruising for a bruising. Plus, ECW Tag Team Champions Kevin Sullivan and The Tazmaniac take on Mikey Whipwreck and Keith Scherer, Tommy Dreamer battles Shane Douglas, and much more!

videos.title: ECW Hardcore TV - Feb. 08, 1994
videos.overview: Main event features the legendary Jimmy Superfly Snuka taking on Tommy Dreamer. 911 faces Mikey Whipwreck. Chad Austin takes on Johnny Hotbody. Pat Tanaka vs. Kyle Sheara. ECW Champion Terry Funk, Shane Douglas, Public Enemy, and more.

videos.title: ECW Hardcore TV - Feb. 15, 1994
videos.overview: Frustrations reach an all time high within the ranks of Eastern Championship Wrestling after Shane Douglas is named the new Number One Contender to face Terry Funk for the ECW Heavyweight Championship. Plus, The Pitbull and The Rockin' Rebel team up to face J.T. Smith and Tommy Cairo, Sabu gets some payback, and more!

videos.title: ECW Hardcore TV - Feb. 22, 1994
videos.overview: In the main event, the death-defying Sabu faces Pat Tanaka. Jimmy 'Superfly' Snuka takes on Kyle Sheara in singles action. Mike Awesome faces the challenge of Mikey Whipwreck and Keith Sheara in a handicap match. Tony Stetson vs. Don E. Allen. Tommy Dreamer and more.

videos.title: ECW Hardcore TV - Mar. 01, 1994
videos.overview: On this edition of Eastern Championship Wrestling, Sabu looks for some revenge when he teams with 911 to take on The Bad Breed in the main event. Tommy Dreamer partners with Sal Bellomo and Tommy Cairo to take on Jimmy Snuka, The Pitbull, and The Rockin' Rebel in a Six-Man Tag Team Match. All this and more!

videos.title: ECW Hardcore TV - Mar. 08, 1994
videos.overview: Main event features Road Warrior Hawk taking on The Pitbull. 911 faces Paul Lauria and Mikey Whipwreck in a handicap match. Kevin Sullivan and Tazmaniac battle the Public Enemy in a wild brawl. Bad Breed vs. Johnny Hotbody and Tony Stetson. Sandman vs. Chad Austin. Bruise Brothers face Hack Myers and Chris Ford and more.

videos.title: ECW Hardcore TV - Mar. 15, 1994
videos.overview: On this edition of Eastern Championship Wrestling, Sabu defends the ECW World Television Championship against The Tazmaniac in the main event. Shane Douglas partners with ECW Tag Team Champions The Public Enemy to take on Terry Funk, Kevin Sullivan, and Crash in a Six-Man Tag Team Match. All this and much more!

videos.title: ECW Hardcore TV - Mar. 22, 1994
videos.overview: On this edition of Eastern Championship Wrestling, chaos breaks out when J.T. Smith challenges The Tazmaniac for the ECW World Television Championship in the main event. Plus, Jason shows footage of The Pitbull and The Rockin' Rebel in action, Shane Douglas goes one-on-one with Pat Tanaka, and much more!

videos.title: ECW Hardcore TV - Mar. 29, 1994
videos.overview: In the main event Mike Awesome battles the Human Highlight Reel, Sabu. The Bruise Brothers take on the Public Enemy in a tag team war. Highlights from Ultimate Jeopardy '94. Plus Shane Douglas, Paul E. Dangerously, Road Warrior Hawk, and more.

videos.title: ECW Hardcore TV - Apr. 05, 1994
videos.overview: On this edition of Eastern Championship Wrestling, Paul Diamond challenges Shane Douglas for the ECW Heavyweight Championship in the main event. Tony Stetson partners with The Rockin' Rebel and The Pitbull to take on Crash, Kevin Sullivan, and The Tazmaniac in a Six-Man Tag Team Match. Plus, The Sandman, Hack Meyers, and more in action!

videos.title: ECW Hardcore TV - Apr. 12, 1994
videos.overview: ECW legends square off when The Sandman faces Tommy Dreamer in singles action. Public Enemy defend the ECW Tag Team titles against Mikey Whipwreck and Mike Norman. Jimmy Superfly Snuka takes on Surfer Ray Odyssey. Plus Shane Douglas, Road Warrior Hawk, and more.

videos.title: ECW Hardcore TV - Apr. 19, 1994
videos.overview: A former member of the original Dangerous Alliance makes his presence felt when Paul E. Dangerously leads Sabu to go one-on-one against the legendary Terry Funk in the main event. Plus, Kevin Sullivan and The Tazmaniac in tag team action, The Public Enemy target J.T. Smith, and much more on this edition of Eastern Championship Wrestling!

videos.title: ECW Hardcore TV - Apr. 26, 1994
videos.overview: Highlights of Terry Funk taking on Sabu. A rare ECW appearance from Beautiful Bobby Eaton and Arn Anderson. The Bruise Brothers face Badd Company in tag team action. Tommy Cairo battles the Sandman. The Tazmaniac, Paul E. Dangerously, and more.

videos.title: ECW Hardcore TV - May. 03, 1994
videos.overview: The Sandman goes one on one with Tommy Cairo in an all out war. 911 faces Mikey Whipwreck and Don Carson in a handicap match. The Tazmaniac takes on Johnny Blaze. Ray Odyssey faces Eric Anderson. Plus Terry Funk, Arn Anderson, Beautiful Bobby Eaton, and more.

videos.title: ECW Hardcore TV - May. 10, 1994
videos.overview: Public Enemy defend the ECW Tag Team titles against The Bruise Brothers in a wild tag team lumberjack match. A special feature on the feud between Terry Funk and Sabu. Arn Anderson and Beautiful Bobby Eaton invade ECW. The feud between Sandman and Ironman Tommy Cairo heats up. Paul E. Dangerously and more.

videos.title: ECW Hardcore TV - May. 17, 1994
videos.overview: Highlights from When Worlds Collide featuring Terry Funk and Arn Anderson taking on Sabu and Beautiful Bobby Eaton. Mr. Hughes takes on Sal Bellomo from The Night the Line Was Crossed. ECW TV Champion Pitbull #1 faces Mikey Whipwreck. Plus Shane Douglas, Sandman, Public Enemy, Paul E. Dangerously, and more.

videos.title: ECW Hardcore TV - May 24, 1994
videos.overview: 4-Corners Tag Match with Public Enemy, Bruise Brothers, Funk & Dreamer and Douglas & Mr. Hughes.

videos.title: ECW Hardcore TV - May. 31, 1994
videos.overview: In the main event, Terry Funk takes on Hack Myers. Shane Douglas defends the ECW Heavyweight Championship against Chad Austin. Pitbull #1 faces Damien Stone. Highlights of Tommy Cairo vs. Rockin' Rebel. Tazmaniac vs. Kyle Sheara. Sal Bellomo vs. Don E. Allen. Public Enemy, Paul E. Dangerously, and more.

videos.title: ECW Hardcore TV - Jun. 07, 1994
videos.overview: The Sandman faces The Tazmaniac. Mr. Hughes goes one on one with Mikey Whipwreck. A special feature on the Public Enemy. "Wildman" Sal Bellomo challenges Billy Firehawk. The maniacal Kevin Sullivan faces Keith Sheara. Crash the Terminator battles AJ Power. Plus Paul E. Dangerously, 2 Cold Scorpio, and more.

videos.title: ECW Hardcore TV - Jun. 14, 1994
videos.overview: Two legendary high-flyers battle in aerial warfare in the main event when Sabu takes on 2 Cold Scorpio. The Sandman faces Tommy Cairo in a wild brawl all over the arena. J.T. Smith faces Hack Myers in singles action. Cactus Jack takes ECW to the extreme and more.

videos.title: ECW Hardcore TV - Jun. 21, 1994
videos.overview: The Public Enemy face the Bad Breed in a wild main event that goes all over the arena. ECW Television Champion, The Pitbull, battles Mikey Whipwreck. The Tazmaniac faces Rockin Rebel. A special look at the feud between The Sandman and Ironman Tommy Cairo. Mr. Hughes takes on Chad Austin. Sabu, Cactus Jack, and more.

videos.title: ECW Hardcore TV - Jun. 28, 1994
videos.overview: In the main event, Shane Douglas and Mr. Hughes battle The Bruise Brothers in a steel cage match. The legendary Funk brothers, Terry and Dory Jr., team up to take on Stevie Richards and Hack Myers. Highlights of The Sandman taking on Tommy Cairo in a singapore cane match. The Funks vs. Public Enemy and more.

videos.title: ECW Hardcore TV - Jul. 05, 1994
videos.overview: In the main event Shane Douglas defends the ECW Heavyweight Championship against Tommy Dreamer. The human highlight reel Sabu takes on Chad Austin. Mikey Whipwreck defends the ECW Television Championship against Pitbull #2. Public Enemy vs. Phi Delta Slam. The Funks, Sandman, Paul E. Dangerously, and more.

videos.title: ECW Hardcore TV - Jul. 12, 1994
videos.overview: The main event features a wild brawl with the legendary Funk Brothers (Terry Funk and Dory Funk, Jr.) teaming with Tommy Dreamer to take on the Public Enemy and Hack Myers. The Tazmaniac squares off against Jimmy 'Superfly' Snuka. The Sandman faces Mikey Whipwreck in singles competition. Plus Sabu, Tommy Dreamer, and much more.

videos.title: ECW Hardcore TV - Jul. 19, 1994
videos.overview: In the main event two ECW legends go to war when Shane Douglas takes on Tommy Dreamer. Mikey Whipwreck defends the ECW Television Championship against The Sandman. Cactus Jack, The Funks, and more.

videos.title: ECW Hardcore TV - Jul. 26, 1994
videos.overview: The main event features a six-man spectacular featuring Terry Funk, Dory Funk Jr., and Tommy Dreamer facing The Pitbulls and Jimmy Superfly Snuka. The Tazmaniac takes on Hack Myers. The Bad Breed take on Joel Hartgood and Don E. Allen in tag team action. Plus Public Enemy, Sandman, Paul E. Dangerously, and more.

videos.title: ECW Hardcore TV - Aug. 02, 1994
videos.overview: An in-depth feature looking at the events leading up to Hardcore Heaven 1994. A special look at Mr. Hughes. Mikey Whipwreck defends the ECW Television Championship against Stevie Richards. The Pitbulls take on Phi Delta Slam in tag team action. Paul E. Dangerously, The Funks, and more.

videos.title: ECW Hardcore TV - Aug. 09, 1994
videos.overview: On this edition of Eastern Championship Wrestling, witness The Sandman light up Heat Wave Tour '94 in a match against Ray Odyssey. Plus, The Bad Breed take on The Spiders in a Tag Team Match, Chad Austin faces off against Damien Stone, and much more!

videos.title: ECW Hardcore TV - Aug. 16, 1994
videos.overview: Cactus Jack and Terry Funk take it to the extreme as the ECW arena erupts in a sea of steel chairs. Mikey Whipwreck defends the ECW Television Championship against Jason Knight. Highlights of an aerial classic between Sabu and 2 Cold Scorpio. Plus Shane Douglas, Paul E. Dangerously, and more.

videos.title: ECW Hardcore TV - Aug. 23, 1994
videos.overview: The Tazmaniac and Jimmy Snuka face The Pitbulls in tag team action. 911 faces Mr. Hughes in a battle of the big men. A special feature on the NWA World Title tournament. Plus Terry Funk, Cactus Jack, Paul E. Dangerously, and much more.

videos.title: ECW Hardcore TV - Aug. 30, 1994
videos.overview: In the main event, Shane Douglas faces 2 Cold Scorpio in the finals of the NWA World Title Tournament. ECW legends square off when The Sandman takes on Tommy Dreamer. 911 faces Doink the Clown. President Tod Gordon has a very special message as ECW becomes Extreme.

videos.title: ECW Hardcore TV - Sep. 06, 1994
videos.overview: The Public Enemy defends the ECW Tag Team Title against Cactus Jack and Mikey Whipwreck. A special look at the rivalry between Tommy Dreamer and the Sandman. Jason defends the ECW Television Championship against J.T. Smith. Plus, a feature on Shane Douglas winning the ECW World Heavyweight Championship.

videos.title: ECW Hardcore TV - Sep. 20, 1994
videos.overview: ECW Champion Shane Douglas and Matt Borne deliver a message about the state of ECW. Cactus Jack & Mikey Whipwreck take on Chris Kanyon & Dino Sendoff. Shane Douglas defends the ECW Championship against Osamu Nishimura. The Tazmaniac faces Surfer Ray Odyssey. Jason defends the ECW Television Championship against The Rockin' Rebel and more.

videos.title: ECW Hardcore TV - Sep. 27, 1994
videos.overview: The Sandman battles Hack Myers. An appearance from Japanese superstar Osamu Nishimura. Jason defends the ECW Television Championship against Dino Sendoff. Tensions rise between The Tazmaniac and Dean Malenko. The Public Enemy face Chris Kanyon and Don E. Allen. Plus, Cactus Jack, Mikey Whipwreck, and much more.

videos.title: ECW Hardcore TV - Oct. 04, 1994
videos.overview: Tommy Dreamer battles The Sandman in a wild main event. Jason defends the ECW Television Title against Hack Myers. Dean Malenko faces Dino Sendoff and Don E. Allen in a Handicap Match. Plus, The Tazmaniac and much more.

videos.title: ECW Hardcore TV - Oct. 11, 1994
videos.overview: Jason defends the ECW Television Championship against Mikey Whipwreck. The maniacal Matt Borne battles 2 Cold Scorpio. The Public Enemy takes on Don E. Allen and Dino Sendoff in tag team action. Plus, Tommy Dreamer and much more.

videos.title: ECW Hardcore TV - Oct. 18, 1994
videos.overview: Cactus Jack battles Sabu in a legendary hardcore main event! The Public Enemy compete in tag team action. Plus, Shane Douglas, 2 Cold Scorpio, Tommy Dreamer, and much more.

videos.title: ECW Hardcore TV - Oct. 25, 1994
videos.overview: On this edition of Hardcore TV, 2 Cold Scorpio faces off against Hack Meyers in one-on-one action. Paul E. Dangerously offers Cactus Jack some insight into Sabu. Plus, the ECW Fan Cam highlights the return of Tommy Cairo against Mikey Whipwreck, The Tazmaniac takes to the ring for main event competition, and much more!

videos.title: ECW Hardcore TV - Nov. 01, 1994
videos.overview: On this edition of Hardcore TV, join Joey Styles as he previews all the action and excitement heading into November to Remember '94, featuring The Public Enemy, Shane Douglas, The Sandman, and many more. Plus, Tommy Dreamer goes one-on-one with Tony Stetson!

videos.title: ECW Hardcore TV - Nov. 08, 1994
videos.overview: On this edition of Hardcore TV, see how The Sandman's 'retirement speech' turns into a nightmare for Tommy Dreamer. In the main event, 2 Cold Scorpio faces off against Mr. Hughes in one-on-one action. Plus, 'Iron Man' Tommy Cairo in action, 'The Franchise' Shane Douglas delivers some stunning news, and much more!

videos.title: ECW Hardcore TV - Nov. 15, 1994
videos.overview: On this edition of Hardcore TV, relive The Public Enemy challenging Cactus Jack and Mikey Whipwreck for the ECW World Tag Team Championships in an incredible battle from November to Remember. Plus, 911 refuses to face the music, a look Shane Douglas' altercation with Ron Simmons and 2 Cold Scorpio, and much more!

videos.title: ECW Hardcore TV - Nov. 22, 1994
videos.overview: Sabu & Taz join forces to face The Malenko Brothers. The ECW Championship is on the line as Shane Douglas defends against Jim Powers.
